card.name: Small words in village-life stories
card.fires_on: Small linking words (in, with, on, to, into, of, for, the) in passages about rural villages, island or indigenous communities and their shift toward modern or outside life. The next word often points to town, school, shops or modern change.

modes.label: Links to modernization
modes.description: A preposition after a verb or noun about a community's change or reliance on outside influences.
modes.example: an increased reliance<< on>> processed foods has left them susceptible to America

modes.label: Moving toward towns or services
modes.description: A preposition or article where villagers go to school, shops or larger communities.
modes.example: send their children<< to>> school, and participate in the simple joys

card.writes: It pushes the model away from predicting village words and toward city or town words.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in stories about villagers meeting modern life, and it nudges the text toward towns and cities instead of villages.
